name: Araceli Farms
tagline: Fragrant smell of lavender comes to Araceli Farms – The Vacaville Reporter
description: Araceli Farms is an agritourism farm in 7389 Pitt School Rd, CA, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
